description: This file contains a single exported function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes an array of records related to costs by agent and possibly other categories, transforming the raw data into a format suitable for visualization with Recharts. The function groups data by agent and another category (such as environment or cost_category), handles missing or unknown categories, sorts the agents and categories, and fills in zero values for missing combinations to ensure consistent grouping.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms an array of cost records into a grouped dataset formatted for Recharts visualization, by agent and a secondary category, including zero-filling for missing data points.
